sos.unexpected.title: Unexpected Period – Quick Guide
sos.unexpected.tip1: Use toilet paper or a tissue as a temporary pad until you can get a proper one.
sos.unexpected.tip2: Look for a sanitary pad in nearby pharmacies, supermarkets, or a restroom vending machine.
sos.unexpected.tip3: Rinse underwear with cold water — hot water sets stains.
sos.unexpected.tip4: Most schools, offices and public buildings have pads — don't hesitate to ask a trusted person.
sos.unexpected.tip5: Track this cycle start date in your Belluna tracker for future predictions.

sos.cramps.title: Cramps & Pain – Comfort Tips
sos.cramps.tip1: Apply a heating pad or hot water bottle to your lower abdomen for 15–20 minutes.
sos.cramps.tip2: Take ibuprofen or mefenamic acid with food if you have it and aren't allergic.
sos.cramps.tip3: Drink warm herbal tea (ginger, chamomile) — avoid caffeine and cold drinks.
sos.cramps.tip4: Gentle yoga stretches — child's pose, cat-cow — can ease uterine spasms.
sos.cramps.tip5: Rest in the fetal position with a pillow between your knees to reduce pressure.
sos.urgent.title: Warning Signs – Seek Medical Help
sos.urgent.intro: Go to a hospital or call 112 if you experience:
sos.urgent.s1: Soaking through a pad every hour for 2+ hours
sos.urgent.s2: Severe pain not relieved by rest or painkillers
sos.urgent.s5: Heavy bleeding during a known pregnancy
sos.review: Rules pending clinical review. Do not rely on this result alone.
sos.q.soak: Are you soaking through a pad or tampon every hour for 2 hours or more?
sos.q.faint: Do you feel faint, very dizzy, or have you fainted?
sos.q.pain: Is the pain severe and not relieved by your usual measures?
sos.q.fever: Do you have pelvic pain together with fever?
sos.q.preg: Could you be pregnant and have one-sided pain or bleeding?
sos.q.pregbleed: Are you bleeding during a pregnancy you know about?
sos.r.emergency.b: Your answers include warning signs. Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.
sos.r.urgent.b: Your answers suggest you should speak to a doctor soon.
sos.r.selfcare.b: No warning signs came up. Rest, drink fluids and use warmth for comfort. Track your symptoms and see a doctor if things get worse.
sos.sub: Your answers stay on this device and are never saved.
